verdict.rationale: CodeRabbit can be driven in natural language across several surfaces. In PRs you can ask follow-up questions, challenge recommendations, and prompt it to generate improvements. You can teach it review preferences through chat. Its Slack agent investigates, plans, and edits code in natural language, and Change Stack offers chat pinned to a review. Many control actions (pause, resume, full review, configuration) still use structured @coderabbitai keyword commands, and the only independent corroboration is a hedged community comment that it 'supposedly' remembers PR feedback. Missing for 10: evidence that configuration and admin operations can be done in free-form natural language rather than fixed commands, and independent hands-on confirmation of the natural-language workflows.
